paragraphs.text: Moses declares to the people his approaching death, and encourageth them, and Joshua, Deu 31:1-8. He delivereth the law unto the priests to read it every seventh year to the people, Deu 31:9-13. God putteth Joshua into his office; foretelleth to Moses and him the future disobedience and misery of the people; enjoineth Moses a song to testify against the people, Deu 31:14-23. Moses chargeth the Levites to lay up the book of the law beside the ark of the covenant, Deu 31:24-27 assembleth all the people to hear his song, Deu 31:28-30.
